title: Pulse Field Gel Electrophoresis for Long Read Sequencing
author: Benjamin Schwessinger
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.83jhykn

steps.title: Prepare Buffers and Agarose Gel
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary TBE buffer and the 1% agarose gel solution.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 2 L of 0.5x TBE buffer.
Prepare 100 ml of 0.5x TBE buffer in a separate container.
Add 1g of Agarose (I/Ultrapure) to the 100 ml 0.5x TBE to make a 1% agarose gel.
Heat and mix until homogenous.
Add 10 µl SYBR safe dye and mix again.

steps.title: Prepare Gel Plug Solution
steps.instruction: Isolate a small amount of gel solution for ladders.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 200 µl of the 1% gel solution to a separate Eppendorf tube.
Keep this tube heated at 60ºC on a heat block.

steps.title: Initialize PFGE Hardware
steps.instruction: Set up the CHEF unit and cooling system.

substeps.instruction: Pour the 2L of 0.5x TBE into the central tray of the PFGE container.
Switch on the power and pump switches on the main CHEF unit.
Switch on the power for the cooling module and set it to 14ºC.
Set the variable speed pump to 55.
Wait until container current temperature is 14 degrees.

steps.title: Cast the Gel
steps.instruction: Cast the agarose gel and incorporate ladders.

substeps.instruction: Pour the remaining molten gel into the casting tray.
Assemble the casting tray, ensuring screws are tightened to make the setup watertight.
Add the gel comb to the comb slot closest to the edge.
Allow the gel to cool and solidify without disruption.
Remove the well comb.
Add any gel-stored ladders (less than 1 mm) to the gel while it is still in the casting tray (advisable to use at least 2 sets of ladders on both sides of the samples, using 4 wells total).
Add the warm 200 µl of agarose over the gel plug ladders and wait for them to cool.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA samples and loading dye.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 ng of DNA (or as close to) for each sample to a prepared tube.
Make up the volume to 16 µl using the buffer the DNA is stored in.
Prepare a PCR tube with 4 µl of loading dye for each sample.

steps.title: Load and Run Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load the samples into the cell and execute the run program.

substeps.instruction: When the current temperature of the TBE buffer is around 14 ºC, switch off the pump and cooling system.
Unscrew the front and rear sides of the casting tray and place the gel in the central slot of the electrophoresis cell.
Load the samples and any liquid ladders.
Set program 1 and start the run.
Wait for around 10 minutes, then verify that the gel is running (dye should be entering the gel).
Switch the pump and cooling module back on; set the pump to around 80 and the cooling module to 14ºC.

steps.title: Post-Run Processing
steps.instruction: Recover the gel and image the results.

substeps.instruction: After the program finishes, remove the gel and place it in the smallest suitable tray that allows the gel and backplate to slip in and out comfortably.
Image the gel as usual.
Dispose of the gel and rinse and dry the gel backplate.

steps.title: System Flush and Cleanup
steps.instruction: Flush the system with RO/DI water and dry the cell.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the CHEF program is inactive and the pump and cooling module are switched off.
Place a large bucket (2L or more) below the output port (marked 'TUBE TO CHILLER').
Fill a second large bucket (2-5L) with RO/DI water and place it within reach of the cooling module input tube.
Disconnect the tube leading to the cooling module to allow buffer to drain into the output container.
Place the tube leading to the cooling module into the clean water container and turn the pump on.
Drain the output container and refill the clean water container as needed until approximately 6 L of water has been flushed through the system.
Place a drainage container under the rear input port (from the pump) of the electrophoresis cell.
Disconnect the pump tube and let the remaining flush water drain from the cell.
Disconnect the tube between the cooling module and pump.
Leave the tubes disconnected and the cell lid ajar to dry (reconnect after one week if not in use to prevent dust build-up).
